name: Workbench
intro: Workbench is SmartVideo's multi-track editor for the things you generate. Bring clips, images and audio onto a timeline, add motion cards and sound, and export a finished video.

features.add-your-generations: The Add your generations button opens a picker with your recent videos, images and audio. Select the tiles you want and add them to the timeline in one step.
features.library-media-motion-sound-themes: The library has four tabs: Media, Motion, Sound and Themes. Click an item to preview it, then drag it onto the timeline. Hover motion thumbnails to see them animate.
features.upload-from-computer: In the Media tab, you can drop in your own video, image or audio file from your computer, so your footage and music sit beside your generations.
features.timeline: The timeline stacks tracks, and upper tracks cover lower ones. Split clips at the playhead, duplicate them, drag the edges to trim, and use Fit to see everything.
features.properties-inspector: Select a clip and the inspector shows its controls. Edit its text and style, set start, duration and speed, and adjust opacity, scale and position.
features.edit-with-ai-chat: Edit with AI lets you describe a change in plain words, like trimming a clip or adding a title card. Every change it makes can be undone.
features.export-video: Export video renders your project to an MP4 right in your browser, and saves a copy to your library, so keep the tab open while it works.
features.project-tools: Along the top you can rename your project, undo and redo, export or import the project file, and reset to the sample. Your changes autosave in the browser.

outro: That's Workbench. Gather your clips, arrange them on the timeline, polish each one, and export. Back up your project file before any big experiment.
